newsitem.title: USA: Wackenhut Corp named preferred contractor.
newsitem.headline: Wackenhut Corp named preferred contractor.

text.p: PALM BEACH GARDENS, Fla, April 4 (REUTER) - The Wackenhut Corp said Friday its nuclear services division has been named as a preferred contractor to provide security services to the eight commercial nuclear power facilities that are members of the Utilities Services Alliance Inc.
Utilties Services Alliance is a not for profit membership corporation representing commercial nuclear power facilities in Kansas, Nebraska, Illinois, Washington, Florida, and Michigan.
Wackenhut's nuclear services division provides security services to 17 commercial nuclear power generating facilities in the United States.
Wackenhut is a worldwide provider of security-related and diversified services to business, industry and government agencies.
